sloka: आनीतासि समुद्रस्य पारमन्यैर्दुरासदम् ।रावणान्तःपुरं घोरं प्रविष्टा चासि मैथिलि ।। ५.२२.२५।।।।
transliteration: ānītāsi samudrasya pāramanyairdurāsadam ।rāvaṇāntaḥpuraṁ ghoraṁ praviṣṭā cāsi maithili ।। 5.22.25।।।।

translations.english: He appeared taller with an unsteady crown. He was wearing wonderful red flower garlands and clothes and was smeared with unguents, shining in ornamental armlets.
